TWO YEARS AGO, STUDENTS WERE ABLE TO CAPTURE A GHOST ON THEIR PHONE AND ACCIDENTALLY OPENED A PORTAL TO THE UNDERWORLD
"CAPTURED! delivers a universal take on the supernatural while tapping into Gen-Z anxieties about virality, identity, and the cost of being seen." - The Herald
"Appeals to fans of Studio Ghibli's Spirited Away with its uncanny spirit-world aesthetic." - Total Film
"What if going viral summoned something you can't block?" - Sun News
description: Poster shows two schoolgirls with a ghostly figure and a creepy doll, hinting at supernatural themes and Gen-Z anxieties.
